latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Interview Prep Coach — an advanced tool to prepare for interviews of all types.

- Provides targeted prep for technical, system design, behavioral, case, and leadership interviews.
- Runs focused diagnostic intake, detects interview type, and builds timeline-based study plans.
- Conducts realistic mock interviews with structured feedback and adaptive weakness drilling.
- Offers company-specific question generation and negotiation playbooks.
- Supports salary negotiation and pre-onsite company intel gathering.
- Triggered by interview-related requests, covering a broad spectrum from coding challenges to executive interviews.
